segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate course called Test-Time Learning for Scientific Discovery, today's lecture is on Harness T-T-T: Learn to Optimize Harness at Test-Time for Scientific Discovery. Recent work such as Learning to Discover at Test Time and Meta-Harness shows two active directions: improving the solver through experience, and revising the systems that guide it. Researchers including teams at Stanford and Johns Hopkins contribute to this landscape. Harness T-T-T asks whether we can learn the search procedure itself. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设的研究生课程“面向科学发现的测试时学习”中，今天的讲座主题是Harness T-T-T：学习在测试时优化Harness以用于科学发现。近期的工作，比如Learning to Discover at Test Time和Meta-Harness，展示了两个活跃的方向：通过经验改进求解器，以及修订引导它的系统。包括斯坦福和约翰霍普金斯团队在内的研究者们为这一领域做出了贡献。Harness T-T-T要问的是，我们能否学习搜索过程本身。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, does that mean the paper improves the agent without changing the model that generates solutions?
segments.zh: 教授您好，这是否意味着这篇论文在不改变生成解决方案的模型的情况下改进了智能体？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The executor, which proposes candidate solutions, stays frozen. Instead, a separate proposer learns to revise the executor’s harness: its prompts, skills, tools, middleware, and execution settings. Think of the executor as a researcher following a protocol, and the harness as the protocol itself. The central idea is to use test-time feedback to improve that protocol, so the same model can search more effectively without changing its weights.
segments.zh: 正是如此。负责提出候选解的执行器保持冻结。取而代之的是，一个独立的提议器学习去修改执行器的harness：包括它的提示词、技能、工具、中间件和执行设置。可以把执行器想象成一位遵循实验方案的研究者，而harness就是那份实验方案本身。核心思路是利用测试时的反馈来改进这份方案，这样同一个模型无需改变权重，就能更有效地进行搜索。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That distinction matters because these discovery tasks are judged by the strongest valid result found within a finite compute budget, not by the average quality of attempts. A good search strategy may matter as much as a capable model. Harness T-T-T retains the best program found so far, then tests proposed harnesses by letting each guide a rollout from that shared starting point. The harness becomes an editable, reusable artifact.
segments.zh: 这个区别很重要，因为这类发现任务评判的是在有限算力预算内找到的最强有效结果，而不是多次尝试的平均质量。好的搜索策略可能和强大的模型同样重要。Harness T-T-T会保留目前找到的最佳程序，然后让每个候选harness从这个共同起点引导一次轨迹，以此测试这些harness。harness由此成为一个可编辑、可复用的产物。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what can a harness actually change beyond the prompt?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：除了提示词之外，harness 实际上还能改变什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It can include reusable skills, generated Python tools, middleware that shapes what happens between execution steps, and controls such as sampling or iteration limits. A proposal may edit only some components; the rest are inherited from a parent harness. This is useful because a task-specific tool or comparison routine can change how the executor explores, even though the executor’s underlying model remains fixed.
segments.zh: 它可以包含可复用的技能、生成的 Python 工具、在执行步骤之间起作用的中间件，以及采样或迭代上限之类的控制项。一次提案可能只修改其中一部分组件，其余组件则从父级框架继承。这很有用，因为特定任务的工具或比较例程可以改变执行器的探索方式，即使执行器底层的模型保持不变。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The proposer is the part that learns across rounds. It receives the current task state and a compact experience digest rather than the entire history of candidates. Only its lora adapter is trained; the executor is not. The digest is meant to preserve useful lessons without making the proposer sift through an ever-growing archive. Harness selection also keeps a runner-up parent to retain some diversity.
segments.zh: 提出者是在多轮之间进行学习的那部分。它接收当前任务状态和一份精简的经验摘要，而不是候选方案的完整历史。只有它的 LoRA 适配器会被训练，执行器则不训练。这份摘要旨在保留有用的经验教训，同时不让提出者去翻查一个不断增长的档案库。Harness 选择还会保留一个次优的父代，以维持一定的多样性。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does the system tell whether a harness helped, when each one gets only one stochastic rollout?
segments.zh: 当每个测试框架只做一次随机轨迹时，系统怎么判断某个框架到底有没有起作用？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is a real credit-assignment problem: a score reflects both the harness and randomness in the executor’s behavior. The paper uses a group-relative policy-gradient method called R-L-O-O, with leave-one-out advantages, reward shaping, and extra emphasis on stronger proposals. Near-ties are collapsed, and all-valid tied groups are excluded from training. The authors describe the combined objective as a heuristic, not an unbiased gradient estimate.
segments.zh: 这是一个真实的信用分配问题：分数既反映了harness，也反映了执行器行为中的随机性。论文采用了一种叫R-L-O-O的组相对策略梯度方法，带有留一法优势、奖励塑形，并额外强调更强的提案。接近平局的结果会被合并，所有有效但打平的组会被排除在训练之外。作者把这种组合目标描述为一种启发式方法，而不是无偏的梯度估计。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The practical scale is substantial. In the standard nine-billion-parameter configuration, each task runs for 20 rounds, with 32 harness proposals per round and up to 20 evaluator calls per rollout. The 27-billion-parameter configuration uses fewer proposals and calls to manage cost. Across 14 tasks, including mathematical constructions, systems work, G-P-U kernels, astrodynamics, and biological denoising, the evaluation tests varied forms of discovery.
segments.zh: 实际规模相当可观。在标准的九十亿参数配置下，每个任务运行20轮，每轮有32个工具框架提案，每次轨迹最多调用20次评估器。270亿参数配置则减少提案和调用次数以控制成本。在14个任务中，包括数学构造、系统工作、GPU内核、天体动力学和生物去噪，评估测试了多种形式的发现。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can generated tools see the evaluator’s hidden implementation or the correct answer?
segments.zh: 生成出来的工具能看到评估器的隐藏实现或正确答案吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They are not supposed to. Generated tools use a restricted interface for reading task inputs and program state, staging edits, and requesting scores. Their code must pass schema and static checks, plus a sandboxed self-test; failed tools can be repaired twice before being discarded. These controls aim to reduce leakage, but the authors note that trusted runtime and validation components are not in the public artifact, so independent verification remains limited.
segments.zh: 它们本不该看到。生成的工具通过一个受限接口来读取任务输入和程序状态、暂存编辑以及请求评分。它们的代码必须通过模式校验和静态检查，还要经过沙箱自测；未通过的工具可以修复两次，之后才会被丢弃。这些控制措施旨在减少泄漏，但作者指出，可信的运行时和验证组件并未包含在公开制品中，因此独立验证仍然有限。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The results are promising but not uniform. With a frozen nine-billion-parameter Qwen executor, Harness T-T-T beats OpenEvolve on all 11 tasks shared with Finch, and beats Finch on those 11 as reported. It has the strongest open-weight result at or below 10 billion parameters on nine tasks. For circle packing, the score rises from 1.17 with OpenEvolve to 2.636. Yet it trails some methods on autocorrelation II and transaction scheduling.
segments.zh: 结果令人期待，但并不均衡。在使用冻结的九十亿参数Qwen执行器时，Harness T-T-T在与Finch共享的全部11个任务上都优于OpenEvolve，并且在这些11个任务上也如报告所述优于Finch。在九个任务上，它取得了参数量不超过100亿的开源权重模型中的最佳结果。在圆 packing 任务上，分数从OpenEvolve的1.17提升到2.636。不过，它在自相关II和事务调度上落后于一些方法。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And the Erdős result—does it set the best reported value?
segments.zh: 那Erdős的结果呢，它是不是报告中的最佳值？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. Harness T-T-T reports 0.380919, slightly improving on the cited human reference of 0.380927. But the table includes a stronger published frontier of 0.380859, which it does not surpass. That distinction illustrates why a striking task-level comparison needs careful context. More broadly, the paper’s ablations suggest proposer training adds value beyond editing the harness in context, while wider proposal search can improve outcomes at greater computational cost.
segments.zh: 不，Harness T-T-T报告的是0.380919，比所引用的人类参考值0.380927略有提升。但表中还列出了一个更强的已发表前沿值0.380859，它并未超越该值。这一区别说明，为什么一个引人注目的任务级比较需要谨慎的背景。更广泛地说，论文的消融实验表明，提议者训练在上下文编辑harness之外还能带来额外价值，而更广泛的提议搜索可以在更高计算成本下改善结果。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The work connects naturally to T-T-T-Discover, which learns from evaluated attempts, and Meta-Harness, which refines harnesses around fixed models. Harness T-T-T combines those themes by training the proposer while keeping the executor frozen. It also reports improved results with a larger configuration and successful use with G-P-T five point five, but continued search is part of those transfer experiments, so they do not isolate transfer alone.
segments.zh: 这项工作和T-T-T-Discover以及Meta-Harness都有自然的联系：前者从经过评估的尝试中学习，后者围绕固定模型来改进harness。Harness T-T-T把这两条思路结合起来，训练提议者，同时保持执行器冻结。它还报告了在更大配置下结果的提升，以及在G-P-T五点五上的成功使用，但这些迁移实验中仍然包含持续的搜索，所以并不能单独隔离出迁移的效果。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So should we view harness learning as a replacement for model training, or as another component?
segments.zh: 那么，我们应该把harness学习看作模型训练的替代方案，还是另一个组成部分？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: As another component. The paper suggests that learning how to organize search can complement scaling models or training executors directly. But its evidence has limits: main results use selected single-campaign outcomes, some ablations cover few tasks, and comparisons can differ in starting programs and budgets. Repeated runs and independent audits of the safety controls would strengthen the case. The broader research question is how to evaluate search procedures fairly, not just how to find one strong result.
segments.zh: 作为另一个组成部分。论文提出，学习如何组织搜索，可以补充模型 scaling，或直接训练执行器。但它的证据有局限：主要结果用的是选定的单次活动结果，一些消融实验覆盖的任务很少，而且比较可能在起始程序和预算上有所不同。重复运行和对安全控制的独立审计会增强论证。更广泛的研究问题是如何公平地评估搜索流程，而不只是如何找到一个强结果。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that an agent’s capabilities are shaped not only by the model that proposes solutions, but also by the tools, workflow, and decision rules that direct its effort. Harness T-T-T makes that surrounding process an explicit object of learning and reuse. Its results support further study, while its evaluation and verification limits call for care. In scientific discovery, improving the search protocol may be as important as improving the researcher. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，一个智能体的能力不仅取决于提出方案的模型，还取决于引导其投入的工具、工作流和决策规则。Harness T-T-T 把这套周边流程变成了一个明确的学习和复用对象。它的结果值得进一步研究，但其评估和验证上的局限也提醒我们要谨慎。在科学发现中，改进搜索协议也许和改进研究者同样重要。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手或留言评论。
